csv-diff-content-key.text: When no --key is given, csv-diff should compare rows by their contents and display added/removed rows without errors. Equal rows must not become spurious differences.

csv-diff-dotted-columns.text: csv-diff should compare CSV files containing dots in column names. Preserve the exact column name in the changes output and support keyed comparison without an exception.

csvkit-empty-stack.text: csvstack must accept an empty CSV file when stacking it with a normal CSV, without error and without losing the normal rows.

csvkit-quote-nonnumeric.text: csvformat should support --out-quoting 2 (QUOTE_NONNUMERIC), quoting string values and writing numeric values without quotes. Preserve ordinary output.

csvkit-right-join-columns.text: csvjoin --right must use the correct join column from each input when the key columns have different positions. Preserve matched and unmatched right-hand rows.

csvkit-sql-length-defaults.text: csvsql should default --min-col-len and --col-len-multiplier to 1. Preserve explicit values and ordinary CSV processing.

sqlite-utils-column-case.text: Match public Python API column names against the schema case-insensitively, as SQLite does. Inserting with a differently cased primary-key name should populate last_pk correctly; preserve exact-case inserts.

sqlite-utils-convert-multi-dryrun.text: Fix combining convert --multi with --dry-run. Preview the multiple output columns without changing stored rows; retain ordinary convert behavior.

sqlite-utils-delete-transaction.text: Ensure delete_where commits its deletion so it survives closing and reopening the database. Preserve ordinary row deletion.

sqlite-utils-duplicate-result-columns.text: Preserve all values in query results with duplicate column names. Rename later duplicates using numeric suffixes, skipping names already present in the query. Preserve ordinary query results.

sqlite-utils-escaped-default.text: Default-value introspection should unescape doubled single quotes in SQL string defaults. A default of O followed by an apostrophe and Brien must return the true string, not the SQL-escaped representation.

sqlite-utils-fts-bracket-table.text: detect_fts and enable_fts(replace=True) should handle legacy bracket-quoted content table names. Preserve ordinary FTS setup.

sqlite-utils-fts-similar-names.text: Fix detect_fts() confusing similarly named tables. Each table must identify its own full-text search table, regardless of creation order.

sqlite-utils-header-only-csv.text: CSV insertion using --detect-types must handle a CSV containing only a header without AssertionError. Preserve regular CSV insertion.

sqlite-utils-ignore-last-pk.text: Fix table.insert(..., pk=..., ignore=True) after a previous insert into another table: report the actual inserted or existing primary key rather than a stale connection lastrowid.

sqlite-utils-keyword-default.text: Introspection of SQL DEFAULT TRUE, FALSE and NULL should return their proper Python values. Preserve string defaults and ordinary table introspection.

sqlite-utils-list-last-pk.text: last_pk should work for single list-mode rows during insert/upsert. Preserve the existing generator-based list-mode interface and row contents.

sqlite-utils-migration-stop-validation.text: migrate --stop-before must reject unknown migration names instead of applying every migration. Preserve compatibility with legacy duck-typed migration collections: pass a single name for one stop point and reject multiple stop points for a legacy set. Preserve normal migration execution.

sqlite-utils-numeric-empty-transform.text: When transforming TEXT columns to INTEGER, FLOAT or REAL, empty strings should become NULL instead of zero. Preserve nonempty values and existing schema transformations.

sqlite-utils-offset-without-limit.text: Allow rows_where and pks_and_rows_where to accept offset without limit. SQLite requires LIMIT before OFFSET; use LIMIT -1 to express unlimited rows. Preserve ordinary limited and unfiltered reads.
